name: Suzuki SV1000
intro: The big brother to the SV650. Some 2003-2006 bikes are in a fuel tank recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2003 SV1000 and 2003-2006 SV1000S bikes are in recall 06V013 for the fuel tank.
A-002.reason: A fuel tank fault can leak fuel. The fix is free.
